items: Fixed: fire engines, ambulances and police cars stay in their own lane instead of overtaking, so they can't block the whole road any more

Better: on the High Alpine Pass the glacier looks like real blue-grey ice with cracks and an icy cliff at the end, the snow walls show their layers and the scoops the snow blower cut, the rock tunnels are made of real-looking rock, and big cliffs don't look stripy like a cake any more

New: High Alpine Pass! Ten levels at the top of the mountains, where meltwater runs across the road (it's slippery!), past a giant glacier, between snow walls taller than you, down a stack of numbered hairpins, past the old hospice and its St Bernard dogs, through rock tunnels with windows, over a huge dam, under crags full of ibex, round the Hotel Belvedere, and all the way down The Pass from the summit sign to the village
Better: parked cars on driveways and in car parks are proper, shiny cars now, in lots of colours, not boxy blocks
New: a yellow post bus climbs the High Alpine Pass, with lots of motorbikes and camper vans
Better: on the Coastal Cliffs the sea is deep blue with rolling waves that sparkle in the sun, white surf breaks at the foot of the cliffs, and the cliffs are dark rock with yellow lichen

New: Coastal Cliffs! Ten levels along the cliff tops high above the sea, past a red and white lighthouse, down to a fishing harbour, over a giant sea arch, through a rock gallery with windows to the sea, under spinning wind turbines, along a beach full of huts, round tight hairpins above a shipwreck, through a castle gate, over a cove with a train on a viaduct, and all the way to the cliff-top cafe
New: on the Coastal Cliffs big side winds blow in off the sea and push you across the road. Steer into the gusts to stay in your lane!
Better: at night you can see into the lit windows in the city, with rooms, furniture and shop shelves behind the glass, instead of flat glowing squares
Better: in Desert Canyon you can see the dam's giant curved concrete wall dropping away below the road, the mesas sit properly on the ground, and the red boulders are smooth and rounded

New: City at Night! Ten levels down steep streets after dark, past neon signs and lit windows, tram lines, a Chinatown gate with red lanterns, a big red suspension bridge, an orange-lit tunnel, a floodlit stadium, a night market, a turning ferris wheel, between the tallest towers and all the way down to the docks
Better: Desert Canyon has a deep blue desert sky, and the odd dark stains on the sand are gone
Better: in the Pine Forest the pines have rounder, bushier tops, the chimney smoke curls up and drifts in the wind, and Burnt Ridge really looks burnt, with black scorched ground and grey ash

New: Desert Canyon! Ten levels through red rock country, past a neon motel, under a giant rock arch, through a narrow slot canyon, across the top of a dam, racing a freight train, through a ghost town and blowing dust, and down The Big Drop
New: logging trucks piled high with tree trunks rumble through the Pine Forest

New: Pine Forest! Ten levels through tall pines, with grit on the inside of the bends, a ride through a giant redwood's trunk, an old railway trestle, a smoking sawmill, Cabin Lake, Burnt Ridge and a log bridge over the rapids
Better: the seaside in School Run has a sandy beach sloping down to the waves, and the pier now reaches out to sea
Better: on High and Ultra graphics the glow no longer turns sunny skies into a white fog, and those settings run faster too
New: School Run ends on a real sandy beach, with darker wet sand down by the water
New: at night the street lamps light up the road and pavements below them with a warm orange glow
Better: pavements in the suburbs are made of real paving slabs, and side roads are proper tarmac
New: in the Hillside Suburbs, cars wait at side roads with their indicators flashing, then pull out when it's clear, and traffic slows down for the mini roundabouts
New: Hillside Suburbs has its own look ready, with a sunny seaside sky, neat mown lawns with daisies, and paving slabs for the pavements

New: Hillside Suburbs is here! Ten new levels down the streets of a seaside town, where traffic keeps left. Slow down for speed humps (hit one too fast and you'll go flying), watch for cars pulling out of side roads, stop at zebra crossings with flashing beacons, go round mini roundabouts, ride under a railway bridge as a train rumbles over, past the school, the shops, the park and the allotments, down a very steep street and all the way to the beach huts and the pier
Fixed: in fog, car headlights no longer make a pale square on the road
Better: Dartmoor looks more like Dartmoor, with leafy hedges on the banks, patches of heather and rusty bracken, thick mist on misty days and brown peaty water in the ford
Better: snowy levels are properly snowy, with white hills and snow on the trees, and the snowflakes are soft and round
Better: motorbikes have sharper fairings and proper exhausts, and their riders look sturdier, in leathers of different colours

Better: cars, vans and pickups look much more real. They have proper headlights you can actually see, slimmer windscreen pillars, sleeker bonnets and better shapes, and the ambulance isn't so tall any more
Better: you can see down into the dark pit under a cattle grid, between the bars
Fixed: cattle grids sit flat in the road instead of poking through it, with the walls running right alongside them
Fixed: the game no longer gets stuck loading on some phones and tablets. The clouds now appear a moment after the level starts
Fixed: cattle grids reach right across to the walls, so no sheep can sneak round them
Fixed: gates at cattle grids sit neatly in the gap in the wall now
Better: Dartmoor's granite tors are rough, rounded heaps of rock now, and the stone walls are bumpy and tumbledown, with stones fallen into the grass

New: keep your stars safe! On the Settings screen, SAVE BACKUP puts your stars and best scores in a file (on iCloud Drive or Google Drive, say) and LOAD BACKUP brings them back. Played in Safari and the home screen app? COPY MY STARS in one and PASTE MY STARS in the other to bring them together

New: fire engines, ambulances and police cars with flashing blue lights! They zoom past and overtake, so one might come at you on your side of the road. Look out for sports cars, convertibles, ice cream vans, horseboxes and red double-decker buses too, and motorbike riders look like real people now
New: real 3D clouds! They puff up into big fluffy shapes, glow orange at sunset and turn dark and stormy when it rains
New: rain falls and snow drifts down as you ride, puddles shine on wet roads, and at night the moon and stars come out
Fixed: the sky no longer has a straight line cutting through the clouds on some phones
Better: grass fades away gently in the distance instead of popping up just in front of you

New: loads more traffic! Hatchbacks, saloons, estates, SUVs, sports coupes, pickups, Land Rover style 4x4s, vans, minibuses, camper vans, lorries, tipper trucks, buses, taxis, tractors and motorbikes with riders, all in different colours, so you won't keep passing the same car. Dartmoor has tractors and farm 4x4s, and at night or in the rain their headlights light up the road
New: the title screen tells you a controller is the best way to play, and turns green when one is plugged in

Better: Dartmoor sounds like Dartmoor. Sheep bleat, ponies whinny, ducks quack at the ford, the pub is noisy, cattle grids rattle under your wheels, you splash through fords, and it goes quiet between the high hedges
New: ride endless mode on Dartmoor, with stone walls, hedge banks, cattle grids, tors, ponies, sheep and gorse along the lanes

New: Dartmoor is here! Ten new levels on narrow moorland lanes where traffic keeps left. Rattle over cattle grids, splash through a ford, hop over a humpback bridge by an ancient clapper bridge, ride past huge granite tors, wild ponies and sheep, the old prison and a very steep hill down to a village. Watch out for the stone walls and hedges, there are no guardrails here
New: tilt to steer on phones and iPads! Turn it on in Settings, then turn the screen like a steering wheel. Swipe up and down, tap and flick still work the same

New: sound effects and music! Your wheels roar louder as you go faster, slides squeal, your glove scrapes and sparks crackle, and the wind howls unless you tuck. Every place sounds different: cowbells and birds in the Alps, a waterfall as you ride past it, church bells in the village, rain when it rains. Cars, lorries, buses, tractors and motorbikes each have their own engine and horn. Change the volume of each on the Settings screen
Fixed: signs, flags, houses and cows from the last level no longer float in the sky when you go to endless mode or another level

New: endless mode has bridges, avalanche galleries, streams and waterfalls, lakes, villages and farms now, with cows, benches and bend signs by the road. Turn them up or down with Bridges and villages on the setup screen
New: a brand new game icon! Your rider, number 7, tucked and flying down a steep mountain road

New: every Alpine level now has its own thing to look out for! Ride through a village, past farms full of cows, along a lake, through a covered bridge and avalanche tunnels, over a waterfall and a giant stone bridge, and under a cable car. Some stretches are flatter and some are much steeper, and the tight bends have warning signs. Rainy levels make the road slippery, so take care

New: endless mode has things you won't find in the levels. Roadworks with cones and loose chippings (get through without hitting a cone for bonus points), YOUR SPEED signs that give you points for going fast, and a mountain that gets wilder the further you ride
Fixed: speed wobbles at really high speeds (like 80 mph in endless mode) no longer fling the board sideways. The board shakes and it's scary, but if you stay tucked and smooth you can keep going

New: make your own endless mountain! Before an endless ride you can pick how steep and twisty the road is, add a speed boost, change grip, gravity and wind, switch off wobbles, and choose the weather, the road surface and how busy the traffic is. Try the presets like Moon, Ice and Chaos, and share your road code with a friend

Better: speed wobbles are much easier to ride through. They build up slowly as you go faster. Tuck and keep your steering smooth and you can keep going, but slam the steering about and they'll still throw you off
New: crashes are way more fun! The rider goes floppy and tumbles down the road or into the grass, and the board skids off on its own
Fixed: hitting the guardrail or riding off into the gravel at speed now crashes you, like it would for real. A gentle scrape along the rail is still OK
Fixed: faraway trees on iPad no longer show up as dark rectangles
Fixed: the menus work with a controller on iPad. Move with the D-pad or stick, A to pick, B to go back, and you can always see which button you're on
New: Xbox controller buttons that make more sense. A pushes, RT tucks (squeeze harder to get lower), LT brakes, X slides and the stick steers. Works on an iPad with a controller too
Better: faraway trees look more like real trees, with light and shade on them, and they change shape as you ride past
New: hand-down slides! Flick back (or hold slide) while you're turning and the rider drops low, puts a glove on the road and sparks fly. Going straight, you still get a stood-up powerslide
Fixed: the rider's arms don't go through his body any more, and he stays in the middle of the board. In a tuck he holds his hands behind his back with elbows out, like real racers
Better: in a tuck the rider's chest and shoulders face straight down the hill
Fixed: menus like What's New and Settings use the whole width of a phone screen, so the words don't get squashed
Fixed: the rider's shoes no longer have odd lumps sticking out of the heels
New: a SETTINGS screen on the title menu. Speed now shows in mph, and you can switch to km/h there. Graphics settings have moved there too
Better: the rider's feet now point almost straight down the hill, so the tuck looks just like the pros'
New: menu and restart buttons in the top corner while you ride. Tap ☰ to pause, ↻ to start the level again. On a controller, press View to restart
Better: the rider stands like a real downhill racer, with both feet turned towards the front of the board and knees and hips following
Fixed: the rider's body holds together in every pose. Gloves, shoes and helmet stay on, and shoulders, hips and neck bend smoothly
New: the game tells you when there's an update! Tap RELOAD to get it, and WHAT'S NEW on the title screen shows what changed
Fixed: letting go of a powerslide no longer throws you off the road. You carry on the way you were going while the board straightens up
Better: powerslides keep more of your speed, and you can steer left and right while you slide. Hold brake to throw the board fully sideways and stop hard
New: air brake! Hold brake at speed to stand up tall, face down the hill and spread your arms to catch the wind
New: levels! Ride the Alpine Meadows campaign, earn stars and pass checkpoints
New: a proper rider in race leathers and a real-looking longboard with 70 mm wheels
Better: much nicer mountains, with a real sky, spruce forests, boulders, grass and rock cuttings
New: install the game on your iPad, phone or Xbox home screen and play it offline
New: Xbox controller support, speed wobbles and highsides when you push your luck, and graphics settings for each device
